author_request: The open-grate icon should be an open padlock, rather than the reused Use hand.
tool: Built-in image_gen.imagegen; edit of the existing project-owned closed-padlock icon
format: PNG RGBA; generated bytes and alpha preserved without resampling; existing native ICON_SIZE projection
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: tiny native automap status icon for Caelum Argenteum, an independent dark-fantasy FPS-RPG. Edit target: the supplied project-owned closed-padlock icon. Primary request: produce its clearly recognizable OPEN PADLOCK counterpart. Keep the same dark iron/grey-silver palette, compact square framing, front view, softly lit painted/pixel-oriented game-icon appearance, dark outlined metal body and restrained antique detail. Open the shackle visibly: one end stays attached to the body and the other end swings outward with a large transparent gap, unmistakably unlocked even when displayed at 24 pixels. Remove the diagonal obstruction/crossed bar from the closed version so it does not read as locked. Retain the lock body and recognizable style; the open shackle is the main difference. Prioritize a bold simple silhouette over fine engraving, matching the existing low-resolution asset rather than adding glossy photorealistic detail. Exactly one centered open padlock, no hand, key, arrow, text, border, label, background plane or cast shadow. Real transparent alpha around and within the open shackle. Output only the finished transparent PNG icon.
